# Axelis Overseas

> Axelis Overseas Education Pvt Ltd (overseeducation.com) is an Indian study-abroad consultancy covering 29 destination markets, from tuition-free public universities in Europe to the UK, USA, Canada and Australia. One counsellor handles each student from shortlist to arrival, and every Axelis fee is published on the site before the student pays.

Corporate office in Bengaluru, Karnataka; registered office in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh. CIN U85500CT2023PTC014913, incorporated 18 July 2023. DPIIT-recognised under Startup India, with British Council and AIRC counsellor training.

Contact: axelisoverseas@overseeducation.com, +91 90985 22711. The first counselling call is free.

How Axelis is paid: the figure on each plan page is the whole Axelis fee. Government, apostille, exam and visa charges are paid to those bodies directly, and Axelis takes no margin on them. Axelis does not promise admission; its refund commitments are defined in the published cancellation and refund policy.

## Student plans

- [Student Plans](https://www.overseeducation.com/products): the two main plans, with prices.
- Global Admissions Charter (GAC): for full-fee destinations such as the UK, USA, Canada and Australia. ₹9,999 onboarding fee.
- Europe Public Charter (EPC): for tuition-free or low-fee public universities in Europe. ₹19,999 service fee, plus a ₹1,80,000 success fee payable only if the student accepts an offer from a tuition-free public university (₹1,99,999 in total).
- Both plans refund the deposit if the visa or the offer does not come. Visa filing is included in both.
- [Start here](https://www.overseeducation.com/start): which route fits, and a free call-back.

## Certification programmes

- [Certification programmes](https://www.overseeducation.com/certifications): concierge programmes with a written refund commitment. EMI is available.
- [Global Career Launch](https://www.overseeducation.com/certifications/global-career-launch): ₹2,00,000, a 12-month end-to-end programme covering strategy, applications, offers, language, visa and landing.
- [PhD & Fellowship Concierge](https://www.overseeducation.com/certifications/phd-fellowship-concierge): ₹2,50,000, covering proposal, supervisor outreach, funding and visa.
- [Executive MBA Concierge](https://www.overseeducation.com/certifications/executive-mba-concierge): ₹3,00,000, covering school selection, essays, recommenders, interviews, financing and relocation.

## Skill programmes and Germany routes

- [Skill programmes](https://www.overseeducation.com/programmes): taught, assessed programmes with a published curriculum and a verifiable certificate. Examples: dMAT preparation for APS (₹25,000), German or French from A1 to B2 (₹1,80,000), and University Application Craft (₹42,000). Prices include 18% GST.
- [Ausbildung and Chancenkarte](https://www.overseeducation.com/vocational): paid vocational training in Germany, or the points-based Opportunity Card. The main fee is settled only once the visa is granted.
- [Test preparation](https://www.overseeducation.com/test-prep): 1-on-1 IELTS, TOEFL, PTE, SAT and Duolingo English Test coaching, from ₹460 a session.
- [Student services](https://www.overseeducation.com/services): services that can be bought on their own, such as MEA apostille (₹1,500 per document plus GST), translation, visa filing and language training.
